name: Barbu
description: Barbu (French for 'The Bearded One', referring to the King of Hearts) is the ultimate compendium card game, a favorite among French bridge players for its strategic depth and psychological complexity. A full session consists of 28 hands, where each of the four players acts as 'Declarer' for 7 hands, choosing from 7 different contracts. The game is a marathon of adaptability, shifting from punishing negative games (where you must avoid specific cards) to high-speed positive games like 'Trump' and the layout-based 'Domino'.

content.text: Barbu (French for 'The Bearded One', referring to the King of Hearts) is the ultimate compendium card game, a favorite among French bridge players for its strategic depth and psychological complexity. A full session consists of 28 hands, where each of the four players acts as 'Declarer' for 7 hands, choosing from 7 different contracts. The game is a marathon of adaptability, shifting from punishing negative games (where you must avoid specific cards) to high-speed positive games like 'Trump' and the layout-based 'Domino'.

Barbu evolved in early 20th-century France from earlier multi-game suites like 'Quodlibet'. In the 1960s, it underwent a resurgence among competitive bridge players, who added the complex 'Doubles' system that turned it into a serious gambling and strategy contest.
Standard pack, specialized Barbu score sheet (to track 28 rounds).
Dealer (rotating) deals all cards. Each player receives 13 cards.

items.text: Trix: Middle Eastern variant with 5 contracts and 4 'Kingdoms' of play.
Canadian Salad: A variant where the negative contracts are combined into one 'Super-Negative' round.
